Maria Gonzalez: Quick check — we need to lock a 60min slot next week for an audit prep sync (threat model + access certification runthrough). Who's available? 

Devin Choi: prefer Tue/Wed morning for me. can do 9:30–10:30 PT.

Samir Patel: I can do Tue but only after 11am PT. Wed works too.

Tina Owens: Wed morning is blocked for me. Thu 10–11 PT is open.

Maria Gonzalez: OK noted. Proposal: Thu 10:00–11:00 PT (60m) to accommodate Tina. Agenda draft below — please add items or flag blockers: 
```
1) Quick context + audit scope recap (5m)
2) Threat model walkthrough (20m) — focus: external integrations, token flows
3) Access certification checklist review (15m) — service accounts, KMS/HSM access
4) Action items + owners (10m)
5) Pre-reads / follow-ups (10m)
```

Devin Choi: Can we add a short segment to confirm telemetry retention & masking? it's an ask from compliance. +1 on Thu if calendar invite goes out.

Samir Patel: Add: review of delegated access patterns for dedicated nodes (esp. RBAC on private deployments). Might need 10 extra mins unless we triage beforehand.

Maria Gonzalez: Good call both. I'll squeeze telemetry into item 3 and move delegated access into action items if time's tight.

Tina Owens: Heads up — I'll need to step out at 10:40 for a 20m conflict. If we can put action items + owners earlier or ensure meeting finishes by 11:00, that's fine.

Maria Gonzalez: Noted. We'll keep timeboxes strict. Also: pre-reads — please skim this doc before the meeting: https://redwood/internal/sec/audit-runbook (focus on sections 2,4).

Devin Choi: leaving a +1. can you drop a short checklist in the invite for reviewers to mark done? makes live triage easier.

Maria Gonzalez: yes — will include a checklist and link to the threat model diagram.

calendar-bot: Created tentative event: 'Audit prep — threat model & access cert' Thu 10:00–11:00 PT. Attendees: Maria Gonzalez, Devin Choi, Samir Patel, Tina Owens. RSVP by EOD.

Samir Patel: RSVP: yes. I'll post a 3-slide summary of delegated access issues in the thread tomorrow.

Tina Owens: RSVP: yes (will join until 10:40).

Devin Choi: RSVP: yes. I'll add telemetry retention notes to the checklist.

Maria Gonzalez: Thanks all — I’ll finalize agenda + checklist and share before EOD tomorrow. If anyone spots a blocker (e.g., can't access the pre-read), ping me here. :thumbsup:
